'''Karoliston''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Kerest system/Legends|Kerest system]]. It was colonized by the [[Kerestian/Legends|Kerestians]] until they were forced to abandon it during an unusual period of inactivity of the system's [[Kerestian sun|sun]].<ref name="GG12" />
